title: power_curve
description: Payload of `stride power-curve`. `fit_r2` is how well the CP line fits its own 5-20 minute bests, and is the query-independent way to weigh the fit. The regression is power against 1/duration, so a LOW value means those bests do not fall on a line at all: CP and W' are then drawn through scatter, and small changes in the inputs swing them a long way. A high value says the line is a good description, NOT that the model describes the athlete — bests taken from steady efforts rather than maximal ones sit on a near-flat line that fits well and yields an implausibly small W'. `fit_r2` is 1 by construction at exactly two points (a line through two points is exact), and 0 when no fit was made at all — `cp` of 0 is what says there is no fit. It is only a quality signal when `fit_points` is 3.

test_known.description: Whether a marked power test is in force today for the named sport's family (ADR 0020); always false when no sport is named. `test_value`, `test_kind` and `test_date` are 0 and empty when false.

ftp_w.description: The named sport's family's FTP today in whole watts, the one stride scores with and `zones` reports for rides: the 60-day derivation (best 20-minute power x 0.95, once two sessions carry one) raised to a marked test in force. 0 when no sport is named or the family has none.

ftp_source.description: Which number `ftp_w` is: `test` when the test in force is at least the derivation, `derived` otherwise (also when no test is in force).

durability.description: Durability: how much of a fresh best holds after prior work in the same session. One row per threshold (500, 1000 and 2000 kJ of work done since the session began, counted from the 1 Hz power stream, so a pause adds none) and duration (300 s and 1200 s), thresholds in that order, each at 300 s then 1200 s. Same window and sport population as `points`. `fresh_w` is the window's best at the duration regardless of prior work, the curve's own point (0 when the curve has none). `after_w` is the best any session held over that duration entirely after reaching the threshold, and `ratio` is `after_w / fresh_w`, at most 1. `known` is the both-possible flag (ADR 0009): false when no session in the window reached the threshold with the duration still to go, and `after_w` and `ratio` are then 0, not measurements. `sessions` counts the sessions that did, so a ratio from one long ride can be weighed as one ride.
